channel.provenance_note: Official Sangiin proceedings service cross-linked from the House of Representatives WebTV. Chromium returned HTTP 200 and displayed a meeting calendar, plenary and committee selection and archived meetings. IPU Parline records the English upper-house name as Senate from 23 July 2026; constitutional quotations may retain House of Councillors. No persistent HLS channel or active live media was validated.
